blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Wednesday left open the possibility that a suspected illegal Philippine offshore gaming operator (Pogo) hub near Camp Aguinaldo and Camp Crame was used for spying, saying forensic examination of recovered materials would help establish its activities. “All possibilities are open,” Teodoro said in an online interview with reporters when asked whether the hub could have been used to spy on the military headquarters and the defense establishment. He said the site was near both Camp Aguinaldo, the Armed Forces of the Philippines headquarters, and Camp Crame, the Philippine National Police headquarters. He […]...
